type.instructions: Classify this GitHub issue or pull request for the pages-seo repo (Cloudflare Pages SEO/blog toolkit).

criteria.bug: Broken behaviour, build/CI failure, deploy breakage
criteria.feature: New capability, provider, endpoint or UI
criteria.noise: Not actionable for this repo (support request, spam, wrong project)

area.instructions: Which part of the codebase does this touch first?

criteria.prog: Programmatic SEO pages and keyword queue
criteria.admin: Admin UI or admin API endpoints
criteria.installer: CLI installer, setup, update, repair flows
criteria.infra: D1, R2, Cloudflare config, deploys, CI

priority.instructions: What priority is this, from the signals in the issue?
criteria: P2: valid bug or feature, not urgent
P1: high impact with a clear repro, or a blocked deploy
P0: security, production breakage, data loss (D1/R2), auth bypass

escalate.instructions: Does acting on this require human approval under the repo rules? Answer yes for anything touching schema/init.sql, functions/_lib/auth.js, wrangler.toml, production deploys, security, payments, or the public API contract (/api/version, /api/health).

needs_info.instructions: Is the report missing the information needed to act on it (no repro, no environment, no expected behaviour)?

duplicate.instructions: Compared with the OPEN ITEMS list included at the end of the state, does this overlap an existing item closely enough that a human should confirm it as a duplicate?
